d:
Viresh Sharnarthi was an FM with a rating of 2300+. He was strong but nothing that would raise eyebrows. He goes to Western Asian Championships in Gujarat and wins the under-20 category! With that he gets his IM title directly and also a GM norm! He then travels to Chennai for Chola Chess International and in the last round faces the 2600+ rated Leon Mendonca. And he has to win on demand with the black pieces to score his 2nd GM norm. And then this happens!
